title: Time Rift
description: A shimmering tear hangs in the air where past and present bleed together. Through the distortion you glimpse landscapes that haven't existed for centuries, overlaid with visions of places yet to be. The edges of the rift crackle with temporal energy that makes your skin prickle.

choices.label: Reach through the rift
choices.description: Plunge your hand into the temporal distortion and pull back whatever you can grasp.

choices.label: Study the temporal patterns
choices.description: Carefully observe the rift's oscillations to collect the echo essence it sheds.

choices.label: Wait for it to stabilize
choices.description: As the rift collapses, it deposits coins from a dozen different eras on the ground.

choices.label: Back away carefully
choices.description: Temporal anomalies are unpredictable. Discretion is the wiser choice.
